C115.name: Kigoma-Ujiji Municipal Council
C115.documented: earthquake on the Tanganyika Rift, large waves and boat accidents on the lake, heavy rain, and cholera

area.en: Kigoma-Ujiji Municipal: Lake Tanganyika shore and hillside streets
area.sw: Manispaa ya Kigoma-Ujiji: ufukwe wa Ziwa Tanganyika na mitaa ya milimani

risk.en: This area lies between steep hills and Lake Tanganyika: storm run-off cuts gullies through hillside streets, low lakeside areas flood, and the dense port and market areas are prone to cholera outbreaks.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko kati ya milima mikali na Ziwa Tanganyika: maji ya dhoruba huchimba makorongo kwenye mitaa ya milimani, maeneo ya chini ya ufukweni hufurika, na bandari na masoko yenye msongamano hukumbwa na milipuko ya kipindupindu.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep drains and gullies clear, build back from the shoreline, and store and treat drinking water safely. What raises the risk: cutting plots into the hillside gullies, building on reclaimed lakeshore, tipping waste into the drains and drawing water from the lake edge near the port. Know the higher street or school ground away from the gullies and the shore that you will move to, go when heavy rain starts on the hills above, and take anyone with watery diarrhoea to the health post the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro na makorongo wazi, kujenga mbali na ufukwe, na kuhifadhi na kutibu maji ya kunywa kwa usalama. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchonga viwanja kwenye makorongo ya milimani, kujenga kwenye ufukwe uliojazwa, kumwaga taka kwenye mitaro na kuchota maji ukingoni mwa ziwa karibu na bandari. Fahamu mtaa wa juu au uwanja wa shule mbali na makorongo na ufukwe utakaohamia; ondoka mvua kubwa inapoanza milimani juu yako, na mpeleke yeyote anayeharisha maji kituo cha afya siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C113.name: Kasulu Town Council
C113.documented: heavy Msimu rain, valley floods, strong winds, and hillside erosion

area.en: Kasulu Town: hillside town and river valleys
area.sw: Mji wa Kasulu: mji wa milimani na mabonde ya mito

risk.en: This area is a hillside town where heavy rain sends flash floods through valley streets and gullies, and lightning is frequent during the rains.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa milimani ambapo mvua kubwa hupeleka mafuriko ya ghafla kwenye mitaa ya mabondeni na makorongo, na radi hupiga mara kwa mara wakati wa mvua.

advice.en: For those living and building here, it helps to keep slopes planted, build away from gully edges and fit lightning arresters on schools and public buildings. What raises the risk: settling in the valley bottoms and gully edges, clearing the slopes above the town and sheltering under trees when thunder starts. Know the higher ground away from the valley streets that you will move to, go there when the stream rises towards the road, and get into a solid roofed building as soon as thunder is heard. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kujenga hapa, ni vyema kuacha mimea kwenye miteremko, kujenga mbali na kingo za makorongo na kuweka vizuia radi shuleni na kwenye majengo ya umma. Kinachoongeza hatari: kukaa kwenye sakafu za mabonde na kingo za makorongo, kukata miti kwenye miteremko juu ya mji na kujikinga chini ya miti ngurumo zinapoanza. Fahamu eneo la juu mbali na mitaa ya bondeni utakalohamia; nenda huko kijito kinapopanda kuelekea barabarani, na ingia kwenye jengo imara lenye paa mara ngurumo zinaposikika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C117.name: Buhigwe District Council
C117.documented: heavy rain, landslides on the highland edge, and valley floods

area.sw: Buhigwe: nyanda za juu za mpakani zenye miteremko mikali

risk.en: This area is steep, densely farmed highland on the Burundi border: saturated slopes slide in heavy rain, and hailstorms damage crops and roofs.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni nyanda za juu zenye miteremko mikali na kilimo kingi mpakani mwa Burundi: miteremko iliyolowa huporomoka wakati wa mvua kubwa, na mvua ya mawe huharibu mazao na paa.

advice.en: For those farming and living here, it helps to keep terraces, trees and grass strips on slopes and to build away from steep cuts and stream banks. What raises the risk: opening new fields on the steepest slopes, cutting into the slope behind a house and leaving roofs loosely fixed. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope, and move there when cracks open, trees lean or water runs muddy from the slope during long rain, especially at night. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kuishi hapa, ni vyema kutunza matuta, miti na mistari ya nyasi kwenye miteremko na kujenga mbali na miinuko mikali na kingo za vijito. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufungua mashamba mapya kwenye miteremko mikali zaidi, kuchimba mteremko nyuma ya nyumba na kuacha paa zisizofungwa imara. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko, na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka, miti ikiinama au maji ya matope yakitiririka kutoka mtelemkoni wakati wa mvua ndefu, hasa usiku. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C118.name: Kakonko District Council
C118.documented: heavy rain in the Vuli fringe, valley floods, and lightning

area.en: Kakonko: miombo farmland and border villages
area.sw: Kakonko: mashamba ya miombo na vijiji vya mpakani

risk.en: This area has miombo farmland and border villages where dry-season fires spread fast, dry spells damage crops, and cross-border movement can carry disease.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya miombo na vijiji vya mpakani ambapo moto wa kiangazi husambaa haraka, vipindi vya ukavu huharibu mazao, na mwingiliano wa mpakani unaweza kusambaza magonjwa.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to burn early and under control, plant drought-tolerant crops and report unusual illness early to the health facility. What raises the risk: burning late in the season on windy days, relying on one crop and hiding or delaying cases of fever or diarrhoea. Know the cleared open ground your village will move to if fire comes, agree early where food and water will come from in a failed season, and take the sick to the health facility the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuchoma mapema kwa udhibiti, kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame na kutoa taarifa mapema za magonjwa yasiyo ya kawaida kituo cha afya. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchoma mwishoni mwa msimu siku za upepo, kutegemea zao moja na kuficha au kuchelewesha wagonjwa wa homa au kuharisha. Fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa ambao kijiji chenu kitahamia moto ukija, kubalianeni mapema chakula na maji vitatoka wapi msimu ukikosekana, na peleka wagonjwa kituo cha afya siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C112.name: Kasulu District Council
C112.documented: heavy rain, landslides, and floods on valleys draining west

area.en: Kasulu DC: hills, valleys and refugee-hosting areas
area.sw: Kasulu DC: milima, mabonde na maeneo yanayohifadhi wakimbizi

risk.en: This area has hills and valleys with dense settlements, including refugee-hosting areas, where floods, landslides and water-borne disease spread quickly in the rains.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina milima na mabonde yenye makazi mengi, yakiwemo maeneo yanayohifadhi wakimbizi, ambapo mafuriko, maporomoko ya ardhi na magonjwa yatokanayo na maji husambaa haraka wakati wa mvua.

advice.en: For those living here, it helps to build off valley floors and steep slopes, keep latrines away from water sources and boil or treat drinking water. What raises the risk: crowding new houses onto the valley floors and steep slopes, digging latrines near springs and wells, and drinking untreated water after a flood. Know the school or church on firm higher ground that is your assembly point, move there with children and the elderly when the valley starts to fill or the slope cracks, and report any cluster of sickness the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi hapa, ni vyema kujenga nje ya sakafu za mabonde na miteremko mikali, kujenga vyoo mbali na vyanzo vya maji na kuchemsha au kutibu maji ya kunywa. Kinachoongeza hatari: kusongamanisha nyumba mpya kwenye sakafu za mabonde na miteremko mikali, kuchimba vyoo karibu na chemchemi na visima, na kunywa maji yasiyotibiwa baada ya mafuriko. Fahamu shule au kanisa lililo sehemu imara ya juu ambalo ni kituo chenu cha kukusanyika; hamieni huko na watoto na wazee bonde linapoanza kujaa au mteremko kupasuka, na ripoti kundi lolote la wagonjwa siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C111.name: Kibondo District Council
C111.documented: heavy rain, valley floods, and a sharp dry season

area.sw: Kibondo: mashamba na vijito vya Malagarasi

risk.en: This area has farmland drained by Malagarasi tributaries that flood crossings and fields in heavy rain, and dry-season fires in the surrounding woodland.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba yanayopitiwa na vijito vya Malagarasi vinavyofurika vivuko na mashamba wakati wa mvua kubwa, na moto wa kiangazi kwenye misitu inayozunguka.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to know the low crossings on your route, keep stores above flood level and keep fire breaks around homes. What raises the risk: trying to cross a flooded drift on foot or by motorcycle, building beside the stream crossings and burning grass on windy days. Know the dry route and the raised ground your household will use when the tributaries rise, and move stores and animals there before the crossings close; if fire comes, go to the cleared ground, not into the woodland. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujua vivuko vya chini kwenye njia zenu, kuhifadhi mali juu ya kiwango cha mafuriko na kuweka njia za kuzuia moto kuzunguka nyumba. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujaribu kuvuka kivuko kilichofurika kwa miguu au pikipiki, kujenga kando ya vivuko vya vijito na kuchoma nyasi siku za upepo. Fahamu njia kavu na eneo lililoinuka ambalo kaya yako itatumia vijito vinapojaa, na hamisheni akiba na mifugo huko kabla vivuko havijafungwa; moto ukija, nendeni uwanja uliosafishwa, si msituni. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C114.name: Kigoma District Council
C114.documented: earthquake, Lake Tanganyika waves and boat accidents, heavy rain, and shore floods

area.en: Kigoma DC: lakeshore villages and the Luiche delta
area.sw: Kigoma DC: vijiji vya ufukweni na delta ya Luiche

risk.en: This area includes lakeshore fishing villages and the Luiche river delta, which floods in heavy rain; lake storms capsize boats and cholera spreads where water is unsafe.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linajumuisha vijiji vya wavuvi vya ufukweni na delta ya mto Luiche inayofurika wakati wa mvua kubwa; dhoruba za ziwani hupindua vyombo na kipindupindu husambaa pasipo maji salama.

advice.en: For those fishing and living here, it helps to wear life jackets, keep homes off the delta flood plain, and use latrines and safe drinking water. What raises the risk: going out in overloaded boats when clouds build over the lake, building new houses on the delta flats and drawing drinking water from the shore near the landing; for new building choose ground above the delta flats, and for houses already there know the exit and raise what you can. Know the sheltered landing you will run to when a storm builds and the higher ground away from the delta that your household will move to when the Luiche rises; take anyone with watery diarrhoea to the health post the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaovua na kuishi hapa, ni vyema kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa, kujenga nje ya tambarare ya mafuriko ya delta, na kutumia vyoo na maji salama ya kunywa. Kinachoongeza hatari: kutoka ziwani kwa vyombo vilivyojaa mawingu yanapojengeka juu ya ziwa, kujenga nyumba mpya kwenye tambarare za delta na kuchota maji ya kunywa ufukweni karibu na mwalo; kwa ujenzi mpya chagueni ardhi juu ya tambarare za delta, na kwa nyumba zilizopo tayari fahamu njia ya kutokea na inueni mnachoweza. Fahamu mwalo uliokingwa utakaokimbilia dhoruba inapojengeka na eneo la juu mbali na delta ambalo kaya yako itahamia Luiche inapojaa; mpeleke yeyote anayeharisha maji kituo cha afya siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C116.name: Uvinza District Council
C116.documented: earthquake, Malagarasi floods, lake waves at the river mouth, and heavy rain

area.en: Uvinza: Malagarasi wetlands and remote lakeshore
area.sw: Uvinza: ardhioevu ya Malagarasi na ufukwe wa mbali

risk.en: This area includes the Malagarasi wetlands and a long, remote Lake Tanganyika shore where floods isolate villages, lake storms are sudden and help can take many hours to arrive.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linajumuisha ardhioevu ya Malagarasi na ufukwe mrefu wa mbali wa Ziwa Tanganyika ambapo mafuriko hutenga vijiji, dhoruba za ziwani huja ghafla na msaada unaweza kuchukua saa nyingi kufika.

advice.en: For those living, fishing and farming here, it helps to keep homes above the wetland margin, travel by water only in calm weather and keep food, water and medicine reserves. What raises the risk: settling on the wetland margin, setting out across the lake with a loaded boat when the sky is building and letting the household reserves run down before the rains. Know the higher ground your village will move to when the wetland spreads and the sheltered landing boats will run to in a storm; move early, because here help can take many hours to arrive. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kuvua na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga juu ya kingo za ardhioevu, kusafiri majini wakati wa hali tulivu tu na kuweka akiba ya chakula, maji na dawa. Kinachoongeza hatari: kukaa kwenye kingo za ardhioevu, kuvuka ziwa kwa chombo kilichojaa anga linapojengeka na kuacha akiba za kaya ziishe kabla ya mvua. Fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kijiji chenu kitahamia ardhioevu inapotanuka na mwalo uliokingwa ambao vyombo vitakimbilia dhoruba ikija; ondokeni mapema, kwani hapa msaada unaweza kuchukua saa nyingi kufika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
